expectations.evidence: Three events defined: OrderPlaced, OrderConfirmed, OrderCancelled — all decorated with [EventType]
OrderState constructor uses `On<OrderPlaced>(...)`, `On<OrderConfirmed>(...)`, `On<OrderCancelled>(...)` — the On<> fold pattern
Confirm() throws if Status == Confirmed or Cancelled; Cancel() throws if already Cancelled or reason is empty; Place() uses EnsureDoesntExist() and validates items/amount
